title: Tekong Gemuk Kampung
mood: rowdy, cheeky, a whole kampung laughing
subject: the round, cheerful tekong of a kampung sepak takraw team who somehow serves them through to the district final while the whole village shouts from the drain edge
caption: Eastern-Indonesian party dance-rap in the 2025 TikTok 'Tabola Bale' style. Bouncy electronic party drums with a dotted, skipping kick and hand claps on two and four; a plucky synth bass bouncing on the off-beats; a bright marimba-style synth lead playing a short four-bar riff; a referee whistle and crowd shouts answering each line. Loud and dry mix, kick and claps forward, crowd shouts spread wide in a small hall. Male voice, a playful mid-register rapper-singer, half-rapping the verses and singing the chorus with a crowd shouting back. 124 BPM, G major. Rowdy, cheeky, a whole kampung laughing. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no dangdut suling, no EDM drop, no slow ballad section.
lyrics:
[Intro - party drums, synth bass and whistle]

[Verse 1]
Petang Ahad gelanggang tepi surau
Pak Mail tekong, perut dia bulat
Orang kampung lain gelak bila dia masuk
Tunggu dulu, tengok dia sepak

[Pre-Chorus]
Bola rotan naik tinggi
Satu kampung tahan nafas

[Chorus]
Tekong gemuk, tekong gemuk
Sekali sepak terus masuk
Lawan pening, pengadil terkejut
Tekong gemuk kampung kita

[Verse 2]
Budak-budak duduk tepi longkang
Mak cik bawa air sirap sebaldi
Lawan dari pekan pakai kasut baru
Pak Mail main pakai selipar je

[Pre-Chorus]
Mata dua puluh satu
Pak Mail senyum, betulkan seluar

[Chorus]
Tekong gemuk, tekong gemuk
Final daerah kita masuk
Lawan pening, mak cik bersorak
Tekong gemuk juara kita

[Outro - marimba synth lead and crowd shouts]
Esok pagi dia jual nasi lemak
Sama macam biasa
